properties.name: spring.webflux.apiversion.default
properties.description: Default version that should be used for each request.

properties.name: spring.webflux.apiversion.detect-supported
properties.description: Whether supported versions should be detected from controllers.

properties.name: spring.webflux.apiversion.required
properties.description: Whether the API version is required with each request.

properties.name: spring.webflux.apiversion.supported
properties.description: Supported versions.

properties.name: spring.webflux.apiversion.use.header
properties.description: Use the HTTP header with the given name to obtain the version.

properties.name: spring.webflux.apiversion.use.media-type-parameter
properties.description: Use the media type parameter with the given name to obtain the version.

properties.name: spring.webflux.apiversion.use.path-segment
properties.description: Use the path segment at the given index to obtain the version.

properties.name: spring.webflux.apiversion.use.query-parameter
properties.description: Use the query parameter with the given name to obtain the version.

properties.name: spring.webflux.base-path
properties.description: Base path for all web handlers.

properties.name: spring.webflux.default-html-escape
properties.description: Whether default HTML escaping is enabled for the web application.

properties.name: spring.webflux.format.date
properties.description: Date format to use, for example 'dd/MM/yyyy'. Used for formatting of java.util.Date and java.time.LocalDate.

properties.name: spring.webflux.format.date-time
properties.description: Date-time format to use, for example 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'. Used for formatting of java.time's LocalDateTime, OffsetDateTime, and ZonedDateTime.

properties.name: spring.webflux.format.time
properties.description: Time format to use, for example 'HH:mm:ss'. Used for formatting of java.time's LocalTime and OffsetTime.

properties.name: spring.webflux.hiddenmethod.filter.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable Spring's HiddenHttpMethodFilter.

properties.name: spring.webflux.multipart.file-storage-directory
properties.description: Directory used to store file parts larger than 'maxInMemorySize'. Default is a directory named 'spring-multipart' created under the system temporary directory. Ignored when using the PartEvent streaming support.

properties.name: spring.webflux.multipart.headers-charset
properties.description: Character set used to decode headers.

properties.name: spring.webflux.multipart.max-disk-usage-per-part
properties.description: Maximum amount of disk space allowed per part. Default is -1 which enforces no limits.

properties.name: spring.webflux.multipart.max-headers-size
properties.description: Maximum amount of memory allowed per headers section of each part. Set to -1 to enforce no limits.

properties.name: spring.webflux.multipart.max-in-memory-size
properties.description: Maximum amount of memory allowed per part before it's written to disk. Set to -1 to store all contents in memory.

properties.name: spring.webflux.multipart.max-parts
properties.description: Maximum number of parts allowed in a given multipart request. Default is -1 which enforces no limits.

properties.name: spring.webflux.problemdetails.enabled
properties.description: Whether RFC 9457 Problem Details support should be enabled.

properties.name: spring.webflux.static-path-pattern
properties.description: Path pattern used for static resources.

properties.name: spring.webflux.webjars-path-pattern
properties.description: Path pattern used for WebJar assets.

deprecation.reason: Replaced by the PartEventHttpMessageReader and the PartEvent API.

values.description: Example date format. Any format supported by DateTimeFormatter.parse can be used.
